messages:
maria_sales: FYI Acme trial is stuck — their traces aren't correlating in Datadog when we export to Datadog + S3. Can we swarm?
acme_it_admin: seeing 429s from /export around 14:02, also the ndjson on S3 has no "trace_id" field in many events.
raj_solutions: looping in devon and kira — any quick theories?
devon_sre: first guess: header propagation or exporter fanout race. Are they using per-route exporters or a global fanout?
acme_it_admin: per-route (route: acme-traces). Here's a sample event we uploaded (redacted):
```json
{"timestamp":"2024-08-07T14:02:17Z","service":"ingest","span":"http.request","attrs":{"status":200,"path":"/v1/query"}}
```
maria_sales: their curl to our ingest:
```bash
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -H "X-Request-Id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000" \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/export
```
devon_sre: ok — two things to try quickly: 1) Ask them to set header `X-Redwood-Trace-Id` with their trace id (our exporter will map that to trace_id if missing). 2) Enable `trace_preserve=true` on the route so our fanout path preserves the trace mapping during parallel exports.
raj_solutions: how do they flip `trace_preserve`?
devon_sre: admin API example:
```http
PUT /v1/routes/acme-traces
{"trace_preserve": true, "exporters": ["datadog","s3"]}
```
alisa_se: note — Acme is on a Dedicated trial node. They don't have KMS for S3 yet; security also needs a checklist for export credentials.
kira_security: for Hosted we can't give customer-managed HSM. For Dedicated we can accept a CMK binding to the S3 bucket — I'll DM the onboarding checklist and required IAM policy.
devon_sre: also on the 429s: bumping `export_batch_size` to 25 and increasing retry backoff (jittered, base 5s -> 10s) reduces transient drops. For now set sampling 100% on their canary route so they can verify correlation, then drop to 10% for steady-state.
maria_sales: customer wants to test this within the hour — can we apply route change now?
devon_sre: applying now.
deploy-bot: route update requested: routes/acme-traces -> {trace_preserve:true, export_batch_size:25, retry_backoff_base:10000} (deploy id d-8231)
deploy-bot: deploy d-8231: started
deploy-bot: deploy d-8231: succeeded :white_check_mark:
acme_it_admin: just after change — Datadog shows correlated traces, trace_id present in S3 objects. Looks good on our side. :thumbsup:
kira_security: sending KMS onboarding doc to acme_it_admin and security contact. Also requesting their KMS ARN and SOC2 questionnaire answers.
maria_sales: thanks team. I'll schedule follow-up call w/ Acme security Tue 10am PT and confirm KD for Dedicated KMS.
raj_solutions: noted — we'll leave the route at 100% for 30m then drop to 10% and monitor console metrics (Console > Observability > Exporters > acme-traces).
devon_sre: I'll add a quick alert: exporter-429-rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall.
maria_sales: perfect — closing the swarm for now. Thanks everyone!
